definitions.explanation: Fireworks that are launched into the sky and explode at height, as opposed to handheld fireworks. A central feature of Japanese summer festivals.

examples.japanese: {打|う}ち{上|あ}げ{花火|はなび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧だった。

examples.english: In summer, I go to see fireworks displays.

examples.english: Ten thousand aerial fireworks are planned for this year's fireworks festival.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's summer ⟦{花火|はなび}{大会|たいかい}→花火大会：10105_hanabitaikai⟧ (fireworks festivals) are major events attended by millions. Viewers wear ⟦{浴衣|ゆかた}→浴衣：04081_yukata⟧ and bring picnic blankets. Contrasts with {手持|てもち}ち⟦{花火|はなび}→花火：00087_hanabi⟧ (handheld sparklers), which are enjoyed in smaller, private settings.
